title: Chain complete against overlap, three recorded sets
caption: The share of held-out sweeps whose chain came out complete at each overlap, in the canonical 18 September page, the superseded summary of the same day and the sweep_v3 ladder of 19 September, all with the annotation's boxes on renders. Every set peaks at two bodies; none is a settled value.
